svg.text: Replay of the recorded NAV series, every line in percent of the day's expected price
The expected price grows at the configured rate and restarts at each reference move (grey), so the bounds are flat on this scale:
upper bound +0.2% (green), lower band edge −0.8% (red). Source (black), floor before the day's checkpoint (blue, dashed).
Daily keeper calls, working defaults. The returned price equals the source on every day.
